newsitem.title: USA: SDC in Czech deal, seen doubling sales.
newsitem.headline: SDC in Czech deal, seen doubling sales.

text.p: SDC International Inc said on Wednesday it signed a sales and financing agreement with Czech Republic-based Skoda Diesel, which it estimated would double the company's projected 1997 sales.

Skoda Diesel was a unit of Czech engineering firm Skoda. Under the agreement, Skoda Deisel's products would come through SDC and SDC would furnish the inventory components for the orders, the company said in a statement.
"As we consider our first operating year for sales to be 1997, we had projected sales of about $7 million," Chairman Ronald Adams said, but he now estimated sales at $14 million.

"Upon full implementation of this deal, revenues should be at least $14 million next year and the return on our capital investment from these orders should be between 28 percent and 40 percent," Adams said.
The agreement was slated to begin in September, but SDC now said it hoped the deal would start in January 1997.
